LESSON: FREE-HAND SKETCHING

Grade: Grade 7
Subject: PRE-TECHNICAL STUDIES
Strand: Communication in Pre-Technical Studies
Topic 2.2: Free-hand sketching

SECTION 1: WELCOME

• Today’s class: Free-hand sketching
• How we learn: Teach → Worked example → Try this
• Use point notes. Show working. Then take the quiz.
• Big question: how free-hand sketches express artistic ideas in different career fields, Why is free- hand sketching important?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

1. Explain the principles of free-hand sketching
2. Identify techniques of free-hand sketching

SECTION 3: CLASS STUDY (TEACH → EXAMPLE → TRY)

▸ Skill 1: Explain the principles of free-hand sketching

Teach
• Today’s focus: Explain the principles of free-hand sketching.
• Listen/read the idea.
• Watch/study the model.
• Then do Try this.

• Model B for “Explain the principles of free-hand sketching” using a home/county example.

Try this

• Share with a partner and improve one bullet.

▸ Skill 2: Identify techniques of free-hand sketching

• Listen/read the idea.

SECTION: QUICK EXAMPLES

• Model 1: Explain the principles of free-hand sketching
• Model 2: Identify techniques of free-hand sketching

SECTION: PRACTICE NOW

1. Practise: Explain the principles of free-hand sketching
2. Practise: Identify techniques of free-hand sketching

SECTION: WORK TO DO

1. Make a one-page revision sheet for Free-hand sketching.
2. Teach someone at home for 2 minutes using bullet points only.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. how free-hand sketches express artistic ideas in different career fields, Why is free- hand sketching important?

SECTION: REMEMBER

• Explain the principles of free-hand sketching
